'''Serrisa''' is a [[Seanchan]] ''[[damane]]''.

==Activities==
[[Egeanin Tamarath]] purchased Serrisa in [[Cantorin]].{{ref/book|10|1}} She was with Egeanin when she captured [[Bayle Domon]]'s ship, the ''[[Spray]]''.{{ref/book|2|29}} Serrisa was left in Cantorin when Egeanin and Bayle sailed to [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|10|1}}
